It is not accessible anywhere else in the game. This page will attempt to include information about both the version before removal and its re-added version.
After wave 5; once per wave, a tower type will be jailed per player.

. Like with other challenges, rewards can only be gotten once a week.
The main change in this challenge is that after Wave 5, random tower type will be jailed. A tower type is every specific tower, like the

, placed down by a player. The towers that get jailed are not the same for each player. While jailed, these towers cannot be interacted with in most ways. This includes placing them down, selling them, upgrading them and using their abilities. These towers will also stop attacking enemies and will no longer summon units. Certain towers however are bugged and retain some or all of their abilities. There is also a secondary change, where the wave structure of this mode is slightly altered, making it harder.

Every wave after Wave 5, a tower will be jailed, making them unable to attack enemies, generate income, provide buffs and summon units.

Units do not get jailed, even if the tower that spawned them is. This makes towers like the
Do note that no new units will spawn from these if they are jailed.
As one tower type is locked every wave, multiple types of towers should be placed down before the towers start getting jailed.
Because of this, it is recommended to focus on multiple tower types instead of a single one. If all your DPS comes from a single tower type, it being jailed puts you at risk of dying to a wave.
Early on, you can place down Level 0 towers as bait, like a Level 0
, so that they get jailed instead of your DPS towers, though do note that if you only have one reliable source of DPS, you are still at risk of having it jailed.
